MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND p.college = 'Michigan State University'
  AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) >= DATE('1964-10-15')
  AND DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) <= DATE('2026-10-14')
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND p.college = 'Michigan State University'
  AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(SUBSTR(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) < 1964
    OR (
      CAST(SUBSTR(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) = 1964
      AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10
    )
    OR (
      CAST(SUBSTR(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) = 1964
      AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
      AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) <= 14
    )
  )
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
